SELECT vb.vendor_invoice_no,
       COUNT(*) AS bill_count,
       COLLECT_SET(vb.ap_doc_id) AS ap_doc_ids,
       COALESCE(vp.payment_count, 0) AS payment_count
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.vendor_bill vb
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT vendor_invoice_no, COUNT(*) AS payment_count
    FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.vendor_payment
    GROUP BY vendor_invoice_no
) vp ON vb.vendor_invoice_no = vp.vendor_invoice_no
GROUP BY vb.vendor_invoice_no
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
